title: Iced Instant Black Tea Sweetened with Low‑Calorie Sweetener

content.title: About
content.content: This instant black tea is designed for making a cold beverage. It is already sweetened with a low‑calorie sweetener (5249), so no additional sugar is needed. It dissolves quickly in cold water while preserving the characteristic aroma of black tea.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Black tea is the second most consumed beverage worldwide after water.
Instant tea was invented in the early 20th century for convenience.
Low‑calorie sweeteners allow a reduction in energy content without sacrificing sweetness.
Iced tea is especially popular in summer, often served with lemon or mint.
The instant dissolution technology retains most of the polyphenols typical of black tea.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Black tea is rich in polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Cardiovascular support
items.content: Moderate regular consumption may improve vascular function.

items.title: Enhanced focus
items.content: Caffeine in black tea boosts alertness and concentration.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: The 5249 sweetener contributes virtually no calories, making the drink diet‑friendly.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Iced tea helps maintain fluid balance, especially in hot weather.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat.

items.title: Allergy to sweetener
items.content: Rarely, an individual may be intolerant to the specific low‑calorie sweetener used.

items.title: Tannin content
items.content: High tannin levels can reduce iron absorption when tea is consumed in large amounts.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Place 1 sachet (or 1‑2 g) into 200 ml of cold water, stir thoroughly until fully dissolved. Optionally add a slice of lemon, fresh mint, or ice cubes.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the sachet tightly sealed to prevent moisture.
